tree.heading: Centers for international business education
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary for the fiscal year 2009 and such sums as may be necessary for each of the five succeeding fiscal years to carry out the provisions of section 1130–1 of this title.

tree.heading: Education and training programs
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary for fiscal year 2009, and such sums as may be necessary for the five succeeding fiscal years, to carry out the provisions of section 1130a of this title.

(a). Pub. L. 101–600 substituted “$7,500,000” for “$5,000,000” and “4 succeeding” for “3 succeeding”. 1988—Pub. L. 100–418, § 6262, amended section generally.
